verdict.rationale: Issuing scoped credentials is a fair question for a package registry and CLI, so the axis applies. The pack only shows that `npm adduser` stores login credentials in the user config. It has no evidence of creating scoped, read-only, or least-privilege tokens for an agent. The `scope:foo` item is a search filter for package namespaces, not a credential scope, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
